items.name: Shoddy Blunderbuss
items.text:
Activate 2

The blunderbuss fires an explosive shot that deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage plus 2d10 fire damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone (DC 26 basic Reflex save save).

When firing the blunderbuss, you must critically succeed at a DC 20 Crafting check or Engineering Lore check or the weapon explodes, damaging you for the same amount as the creatures in the cone and destroying itself. A successful DC 22 Crafting check check is enough to confirm the weapon's unstable nature if someone examines it beforehand.

Reloading the blunderbuss takes 3 Interact actions: adding 1 dose of gunpowder, adding 1 grapeshot canister, and packing the contents.

items.name: Whiplash
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 10 feet of Gerhard uses an action with the move trait to leave a square.

---

Effect Gerhard attempts to Trip the triggering creature. On a success, the creature also takes damage as if Gerhard hit with his whip Strike, and if the creature was flying, it falls 30 feet.

items.name: Manly Left Hook
items.text: A creature struck by Gerhard's punch must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save save or be Stunned 1 (or Stunned 3 on a critical failure).

items.name: Shoddy Blunderbuss
items.text:
Gerhard fires an explosive shot from his blunderbuss that deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage plus 2d10 fire damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone (DC 26 basic Reflex save).

When firing the blunderbuss, Gerhard must succeed at a DC 20 Crafting check or Engineering Lore check or the weapon explodes, damaging him for the same amount as the creatures in the cone and destroying itself. If someone other than Gerhard uses the weapon, they must critically succeed at the check. A successful DC 22 Crafting check check is enough to confirm the weapon's unstable nature if someone examines it beforehand.

Reloading the blunderbuss takes 3 Interact actions: adding 1 dose of gunpowder, adding 1 grapeshot canister, and packing the contents.

items.name: Whip Swing
items.text:
Requirement Gerhard is in a jungle, dense forest, or an area with numerous overhead beams.

---

Effect Gerhard uses his whip to lash upward to wrap around an overhanging tree branch; he then swings up to 30 feet in a straight line, and must end the movement on solid ground or fall.
